bills.title: Health Insurance Amendment (Prescribed Dental Patients and Other Measures) Bill 2023

name: The majority voted against a [request for amendments](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/display.w3p;query=Id%3A%22legislation%2Famend%2Fr6997_amend_fa634dcc-df68-485d-ae85-94b90ac0feb9%22;rec=0) introduced by Victorian Senator [Janet Rice](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/victoria/janet_rice) (Greens), which means they failed. [According to Senator Rice](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?id=2023-08-09.211.2), the requests "*would [have allowed] for 26 sessions of speech pathology within any period of 12 months*".
